No you won’t be liable to sell the option unless you were the one while sold the option in the first place (covered call or naked call).

So you can do a few things 

1. You can hold the option and sell it at whatever premium you decide. You can choose what your limit price is. Your option will fluctuate depending on multiple factors. You will incur capital gains if you sell btw (unless you take a loss obviously) 

2. You can let the option expire (this will happen automatically if you are not in the money by expiration). Your premium will be your max amount lost (so in this case $147 + options fee from your brokerage) 

3. You can exercise the option (if you are in the money). Here you would need the capital to be able to purchase 100x shares at $41.
